p3_gaps_found.title: _audioCtx (Web Audio API new-order beep) AudioContext never closed
p3_gaps_found.evidence: Declared implicitly via this._audioCtx = new Ctx() L2918 in _playNewOrderBeep. beforeUnmount does NOT call this._audioCtx?.close(). Each PosComponent mount lifecycle creates one AudioContext (singleton per instance, lazy on first beep). Browser limit on concurrent AudioContexts is hardware-dependent (~6 per page typical) but the same component instance reuses one. Navigation away → memory pressure of 1 AudioContext per mount cycle if route is revisited multiple times.
p3_gaps_found.impact: Cashier typically stays on /admin/pos for the full shift (no remount). 5h session = 1 cumulative AudioContext. Multi-navigation stress would accumulate. Browser GC eventually cleans dereferenced AudioContexts but explicit close() releases the audio thread sooner.
p3_gaps_found.recommendation: In beforeUnmount, add `if (this._audioCtx && typeof this._audioCtx.close === 'function') { this._audioCtx.close().catch(() => {}); this._audioCtx = null; }`. 3 LOC, no behavior change.
p3_gaps_found.v1_classification: V1.0.X cleanup backlog candidate (same group as G-001).

p2_concern_found_during_audit.title: _kioskPollingInterval() is consulted only at _startKioskPolling() invocation — cadence does NOT dynamically adapt during a running session unless ws-connected or ws-disconnected event fires
p2_concern_found_during_audit.evidence_source_lines: L2617-2630 — `setInterval(() => { ... }, this._kioskPollingInterval())`. The interval value is captured once at setInterval() call. Subsequent change to underlying inputs (readyOrders becoming non-empty, lastReadyRefresh becoming fresh, isStale flipping) is NOT re-evaluated until _restartKioskPolling() is called. _restartKioskPolling() is only called from _bindWsService callbacks L2585 (ws connected) + L2591 (ws disconnected).
p2_concern_found_during_audit.concrete_failure_mode: Scenario A — cashier starts POS shift with Echo silently broken AND readyOrders empty: _kioskPollingInterval returns 5000 → polling at 5s. Orders come in via 5s polling (not Echo) — readyOrders becomes non-empty and lastReadyRefresh becomes fresh. Per the heal logic, cadence SHOULD now relax to 60s (Echo connected) OR stay at 5s (Echo not connected). The static cadence is stuck at 5000 because setInterval captured 5000. This is actually CORRECT in this failure mode (Echo broken → 5s is right). Scenario B — cashier starts with Echo connected + non-empty list: cadence captured at 60000. If Echo silently breaks 30 min into shift (CSP regression, soketi reboot, channel-auth failure not triggering ws disconnected event), cadence stays at 60s for the remainder. lastReadyRefresh becomes stale; per heal logic it SHOULD downshift to 5000, but the running interval is still 60000.
p2_concern_found_during_audit.static_evidence_for_scenario_b_risk: _bindWsService L2577-2595 ONLY hooks 'connected'/'disconnected' events. There is NO listener for pusher:subscription_error or auth failure that would propagate from eventContract.js. eventContract.js L364-366 emits console.warn but does not signal subscribers. So a silent Echo break (channel auth failure with persistent ws socket up) WILL leave _kioskPollTimer at 60s cadence indefinitely.
p2_concern_found_during_audit.impact: Cashier hits the 60s ceiling for ΔT when Echo silently breaks mid-shift. Owner-stated target was ≤5s per H-SYNC-001. Real-world frequency unknown but the CSP localhost vs 127.0.0.1 break that triggered H-SYNC-001 originally is exactly this kind of silent failure.
p2_concern_found_during_audit.mitigation_path: Replace setInterval with self-recursive setTimeout that re-evaluates _kioskPollingInterval() on every tick. OR: in the existing setInterval tick body L2618-2630, after the refresh, check whether the current interval value still matches _kioskPollingInterval() and if not, call _restartKioskPolling() to swap the interval. Both are ~5 LOC + 1 new sentinel test case.
p2_concern_found_during_audit.recommendation: V1 LOCAL Le Cayenne ship-not-blocked because: (a) H-SYNC-001 fixed the dominant scenario (cold-mount silent Echo) which is the high-frequency case; (b) the residual scenario B (mid-shift Echo break with persistent ws socket) is plausible but unmeasured in production; (c) blast radius is bounded — at worst the Q10 panels update at 60s cadence (one minute lag on Prêt-à-livrer rows) rather than 5s, the row CTAs still work, lockForUpdate still prevents multi-cashier race. NOTE: Q10 panels themselves expose NO manual refresh button (the ↻ at L1283 is on the slide-in panel, NOT the always-render Q10 section); the cashier has no visible escape hatch on the Q10 panel itself. Tracked as V1.0.X backlog HEAL-SYNC-002.
p2_concern_found_during_audit.v1_classification: V1.0.X follow-on to H-SYNC-001. Track in BRAIN §4 NEXT TO DO.

findings.title: _deliveryAcTimer (Google Maps autocomplete debounce) not cleared in beforeUnmount
findings.evidence: L1669 declared. L4055-4058 created on each keystroke (clears previous + setTimeout 300ms). beforeUnmount L2038-2087 omits it. 5h cumulative leak = 0 (one instance only) but a navigation away within 300ms of typing leaks one pending callback that fires on unmounted component (mitigated by _destroyed guard if it sets reactive state, but the call still happens).
findings.fix_proposal: Add to beforeUnmount alongside L2076-2078: `if (this._deliveryAcTimer) { clearTimeout(this._deliveryAcTimer); this._deliveryAcTimer = null; }`.

findings.title: _audioCtx (Web Audio API new-order beep) AudioContext never closed
findings.evidence: L2918 lazy `this._audioCtx = new Ctx()`. beforeUnmount does not call close(). 5h cumulative on a single mount = 1 AudioContext. Multi-mount stress would accumulate (browser cap ~6/page).
findings.fix_proposal: Add to beforeUnmount: `if (this._audioCtx && typeof this._audioCtx.close === 'function') { this._audioCtx.close().catch(() => {}); this._audioCtx = null; }`.

findings.title: _kioskPollingInterval() evaluated only at _startKioskPolling() — dynamic stale/empty downshift does not fire mid-shift unless ws-connected/disconnected event triggers _restartKioskPolling
findings.evidence_lines: L2617-2630 — `setInterval(callback, this._kioskPollingInterval())` captures value once. _restartKioskPolling L2632 only called from _onWsConnected L2585 + _onWsDisconnected L2591. Silent Echo break (pusher:subscription_error or channel-auth failure) does NOT propagate to _wsService 'disconnected' event — the socket stays up. _kioskPollingInterval logic at L2602-2615 would correctly compute 5000ms on stale lastReadyRefresh, but the running setInterval is stuck at the captured value.
findings.concrete_failure_mode: Cashier starts shift, Echo connects → _startKioskPolling captures 60000ms. 30 minutes in, Echo silently breaks (CSP, soketi restart, channel-auth cookie expiry) without triggering ws-disconnected. _kioskPollTimer keeps firing every 60s. readyOrders becomes stale (lastReadyRefresh > 30s ago) but cadence does not downshift to 5s as H-SYNC-001 intends.
findings.mitigation_path: Replace setInterval with self-recursive setTimeout pattern that re-evaluates _kioskPollingInterval() on every tick. OR: after each tick, compare current cadence to _kioskPollingInterval() and call _restartKioskPolling() if changed. AND ratchet posKioskPollingCadenceSentinel.spec.js to add an integration-tick test (fake timers + mount _startKioskPolling + mutate inputs + advance clock + assert next tick fires at the new cadence) so the running-clock invariant is sentinel-locked, not just the pure-function decision tree.
findings.impact: ΔT envelope can drift up to 60s in the silent-Echo-break scenario instead of the H-SYNC-001 target of ≤5s. Owner UX target compromised in residual case.
findings.v1_classification: V1.0.X follow-on HEAL-SYNC-002. NOT a ship blocker: (a) cold-mount silent-Echo case (high frequency) is covered by H-SYNC-001; (b) mid-shift silent-Echo break (residual case, unmeasured frequency) bounds lag at 60s on the Q10 panel rows — CTAs still functional, lockForUpdate still prevents race. Q10 panel itself has no manual refresh affordance, so the V1 trade-off is 'tolerable lag in a residual case' not 'zero recovery path'. The slide-in 'À encaisser borne' panel exposes ↻ refresh at L1283 (operator-bar entry → showKioskCashPanel=true), which forces loadKioskCashOrders and indirectly re-renders Q10 cash rows; no such surface for the 'Prêt à livrer' panel without navigating to tracker.
findings.verification_against_sentinel: tests/js/sentinels/posKioskPollingCadenceSentinel.spec.js INSPECTED — sentinel covers pure function decision tree (7 input combos) + 5 source-string anchors. It does NOT cover the running-clock integration scenario this finding describes. Sentinel GREEN is necessary-but-not-sufficient for the H-SYNC-001 'bounded ≤5s under any condition' claim.
